title: CriteriaService on grpc.aio: concurrent, bounded, deadline-aware
scenario: Kestrel's internal CriteriaService checks a PA case's policy criteria against the FHIR store one at a time, never times out and returns UNKNOWN for bad input. Rebuild the servicer on grpc.aio with a TaskGroup fan-out, a semaphore of 5, per-check timeouts as results, proper status codes, and clean cancellation when the client gives up.
task: Validate input with INVALID_ARGUMENT and NOT_FOUND
Fan out with asyncio.TaskGroup under a Semaphore(5), results in request order
Per-check asyncio.timeout bounded by the client deadline; timeout and error as results
Prove client cancel and deadline leave no in-flight work or leaked slots
acceptance: Peak in-flight exactly 5 and wall time well under the sequential time
Correct status codes and per-criterion timeout/error statuses
No leaked work or semaphore slots after cancel or deadline

practices.label: Week 2 Tue - deadlines, cancellation, status codes
Week 1 Mon - asyncio TaskGroup and timeouts
